title: PMB For Fabric
description: Premier Minecraft Baseball official modpack for Fabric
body:
This Modpack will give you the option to play on Fabric
- Made For Fabric Users

If you have suggestions for mods to add to this modpack dm me on discord @Kcroyals_

In Order To See The Baseball Past 64 Blocks **(Required)**, Follow These Steps
1. Open Mod Menu
2. Find the "**Entity View Distance Mod**" 
3. Click On The Settings Slide Bar
4. Scroll Down And Find **"Snowball"**
5. Change **"Snowball"** Distance to **"512"**
In Order To See The Baseball Past 64 Blocks (Required) , Follow These Steps
1. Open Mod Menu
2. Find the "**Entity View Distance Mod**" 
3. Click On The Settings Slide Bar
4. Scroll Down And Find "Snowball"
5. Change "Snowball" Distance to "512"
